create_sam2_segmentation: create SAM2 model segmentation output from input image pixels and point prompts
build_vision_encoder_embeddings: build image embeddings from pixel values using the SAM2 vision encoder backbone
run_mask_decoder: run the mask decoder to predict segmentation masks from image and prompt embeddings
encode_prompt_embeddings: encode point, box, and mask prompts into sparse and dense embeddings via the prompt encoder
partition_windows_attention: partition image features into non-overlapping windows for efficient windowed self-attention
